name: Kobold’s Fury
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 0, cleric 0, inquisitor 1, sorcerer/wizard 0, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (a small scale)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min. or until discharged
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

Your touch bestows a kobold’s rage on the target creature. The target receives a +2 circumstance bonus on the next melee attack roll made against a creature larger than the target.
